The King's Voice — Recorded in the Night

THESE DIRECTIVES OF THE KING

In the night of November 2–3, 2026 — after watching the record of our children being killed in the street — the King spoke. The ceasefire had already been called. These are his words, in the order he recorded them, unedited. Before each, a note from the desk.

A Word to Every Continent — the Speech

The ceasefire stands. The King's Guard is ordered to protect, not to encamp. And every soul is called to be counted.

The Clip — 'Intolerable'

What was laid before the King that night: a child gone, millions spoken of, and no one in a cell. His word for it was one word.

'We Will Research'

The answer: the record will be researched — the names, the calls, every hand in it.

'They All Had My Back'

The last word of the night: those who gave the nod do not stand unseen.
